'''X39-R32''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] which was around [[3642 BBY]] located on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] inside [[Tromper Crags mineral mine]], where it was destroyed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
X39-R32 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was killed.
